general_information.Description: This course explores how media technologies evolve, function, and impact society, helping students think critically about media and culture. It introduces the global media landscape and the ongoing shifts in technology, culture, and critical theory. Emphasis is placed on how new media shape power relations and social connections through communication. Topics include social media trends, digital publishing, Internet governance, privacy protection, online advertising, and the video game industry. Students will engage with real-world issues in a fast-changing media environment.
general_information.StudentTasks: 1. Join the online course (spec.) when being invited by the admin. 2. Enroll in each MOOC of spec., regularly study MOOCs at least 5hrs/week by watching videos, reading materials, taking quizzes, doing assignments... as required 3. Respect the Coursera Code of Conduct, at https://learner.coursera.help/hc/en-us/articles/208280036-Coursera-Code-of-Conduct 3. Keep online learning progress promptly (bonus will be awarded) 4. Communicate and discuss in forum 5. Attend offline sessions in the Campus (Optional) 6. Must complete all MOOCs of spec. with certification in order to take the Final Exam at Campus
general_information.Note: 1) Ongoing assessment: Students who complete all MOOCs before the course deadline will receive 1 bonus point; otherwise, no bonus point will be awarded. 2) Theoretical Exam (TE) 3) Final Result (FR) =min (10, TE + Bonus) 4) Completion Criteria: TE>=4 and FR>=5

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Remember key terminology and concepts related to media technologies, digital communication, and the global media environment.
Understand the role of media in shaping cultural norms, societal values, and communication practices.
Apply foundational media concepts to interpret developments in social media, online privacy, and digital publishing.
Analyze how shifts in technology and media practices influence power structures and social connectivity in contemporary society.
